name: Bard Psychic Dancer
body:
A psychic dancer is a seer more than an entertainer. His dancing trances enable him to expand his senses to a great distance, and even to see in the future.

Sensitive Caster

A psychic dancer casts bard spells as psychic spells, using thought and emotion components instead of verbal and somatic. He also adds the seer psion signature spell to his spells known as a psion of his same level, and considers all the spells on the seer spell list as if they were on his bard spell list (but not his known spell list). This modifies the normal bard’s spellcasting.

Bardic Performance

A psychic dancer gains the following type of bardic performance:

Countering Dance (Su)

At 1st level, a psychic dancer can use his Perform (dance) ability to counter spells and effects that depend on sight, eye contact or affect the senses, like illusion effects, eyebite or a mesmerist’s stare. Any creature within 30 feet of the psychic dancer that can see him dance benefits of this ability. Countering dance relies on visual components, and otherwise functions as and replaces countersong.

Bardic Seer (Ex)

At 1st level, a psychic dancer gains Signature Skill (Perception) as a bonus feat. In addition, he adds half his class level (minimum 1) to all Perception skill checks. This replaces bardic knowledge.

Dancing Performance

A psychic dancer specializes in dancing performances. All his performances rely on visual components only, even the ones which normally use exclusively audible components. A blind psychic dancer has no chance to fail when using a dancing performance, due to his intense training in dancing skills.

Versatile Dance (Ex)

At 2nd level, a psychic dancer gains the versatile performance (dance) ability. At 6th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, he doesn’t select an additional type of Perform skill to substitute, but rather can select another skill to apply his Perform (dance) bonus to. This modifies versatile performance.

Seer’s Vocation

At 8th level, and every 6 levels thereafter, a psychic dancer can select one vocation power from the seer psion’s list. His seer level is equal to his bard level for the purpose of using these powers. If a power requires expending psychic focus, then the psychic dancer can use it only during a performance. This replaces dirge of doom, frightening tune, and deadly performance. The psychic dancer is eligible for the Extra Vocation Power feat.

Master Seer (Su)

At 20th level, a psychic dancer gains the seer’s vocation mastery class feature. This replaces deadly performance.
